verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents connecting MCP servers as a knowledge source, so reviews and chat can pull context from documentation, design, and project-management tools. Its pricing page also lists "MCP connections" as a feature. The documented scope is context retrieval rather than general tool execution, and the snippets give no setup details. missing for 10: evidence of invoking MCP tools for actions beyond pulling context, configuration/setup documentation detail (transports, auth, server limits), independent or hands-on corroboration.
